title: Equivalence Principle violation in metric-affine gravity and finite-temperature effects
summary: Possible violations of the equivalence principle are investigated within the framework of metric-affine gravity and their connection to finite-temperature effects are highlighted. Thermal corrections to particle dynamics, originally derived in a quantum-field-theory setting, can be evaluated in a purely Riemannian framework and lead to a shift in the gravitational-to-inertial mass ratio.
